confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from one search of RBA pages. The latest observation shown was 18 Nov 2026. Food and drink anchors come from one search of cost-of-living aggregators (Numbeo via Expatica, MyLifeElsewhere, Expat Arrivals): inexpensive meal about $25, three-course meal for two about $105, cappuccino about $5, domestic beer about $6. No cocktail price was found, so the cocktail is estimated at about 2.3x the beer price. The wine glass is estimated from the bottle price of about $15.50 plus restaurant markup. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a typical July period, not from live listings. They are the least certain anchors, especially the hostel figures, because Atlanta has few hostels.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other large US Southeast and Sun Belt cities such as Nashville, Miami and Charlotte, with Atlanta's restaurant prices slightly above the US average.
